summary.headline: Soul and Morals in the Horoscope
summary.text: Astrological delineation of the soul and morals from the ascendant’s lord and Mercury, including the effects of fixed signs, angular or succedent placement, and Oriental or Occidental positions. It then details the Sun and Moon as ascendant lords, contrasting favorable and impeded placements and their effects on intellect, character, rank, appearance, nutrition, and growth.
